title: Different horizontal asymptotes · Set 2
statement:
Give the value of $y$ for the horizontal asymptote of $([$a]x+1)/\sqrt{x^2+4}$ as $x\to-\infty$.

[__________]{a}
hints: The constant term in the numerator vanishes after rescaling.
solution: Divide by $|x|$ to get $(-[$a]+1/|x|)/\sqrt{1+4/x^2}$, whose limit is $-[$a]$.

feedback.message: The constant term in the numerator vanishes after rescaling.
